about_subtitle_p1: Graduated in Data Science with a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering. I work as a Full-Stack Engineer with a focus on backend, developing enterprise APIs with Java/Spring Boot and Node.js. I integrate AI into real solutions with experience in intelligent processing and scalable architecture. On the frontend, I create responsive interfaces with React, Angular, and Next.js, always prioritizing architectural excellence and clean code.
about_subtitle_p2: As a contributor to Brainly between 2016 and 2025, I shared over 1,800 academic answers with 12,000+ recognitions. Currently focused on larger-scale projects.

project_novamesh_description: Scalable microfrontend architecture for enterprise e-commerce with domain isolation and independent deployment.
project_novamesh_full_description: Corporate portal developed with Module Federation, allowing multiple teams to work autonomously without coupled dependencies. Each business domain evolves independently while maintaining the visual and functional cohesion of the platform.
project_inventory_description: Full-stack enterprise platform for inventory management with a robust backend and modern interface.
project_inventory_full_description: Corporate solution built with Spring Boot and React for centralized control of products, categories, and movements. Architecture prepared for scalability and data analysis, with documented RESTful APIs and an optimized pipeline for mass operations.
project_messagelove_description: Interactive platform to create memorable experiences with media, audio, and secure authentication.
project_messagelove_full_description: Full-stack application that combines cutting-edge technology with user experience-focused design. Allows creating personalized moments by integrating photos, voice messages, audio, and robust authentication in an intuitive and delightful interface.
project_toy_data_description: Containerized platform for data experimentation, processing, and visualization with reproducibility.
project_toy_data_full_description: Complete and portable data laboratory, developed with containerization to ensure that today and in the future, experiments, analyses, and pipelines run consistently. Ideal for rapid prototyping and scaling to production.
